item.name: mesh-gradient
item.summary: background: multi-color organic mesh gradient via WebGL2 (webgl2, client-only, ~4.5 KB, reduced motion -> poster, DPR <= 1.5 on mobile/Tier 2)

useWhen: Hero sections requiring rich, fluid multi-color ambient backgrounds
Telemetry or premium landing surfaces needing organic color transitions
Sections requiring soft chromatic fields with zero server hydration shift
avoidWhen: Dense text sections without an active contrast scrim
Surfaces already running another full-screen WebGL shader in the same viewport
Devices with battery-saver or forced reduced motion enabled

alternatives.name: noise-field
alternatives.when: When monochromatic procedural simplex flow lines are desired

alternatives.name: particle-field
alternatives.when: When discrete kinematic points and pointer repulsion are preferred

tiers.0: Static CSS multi-radial gradient poster matching mesh colors
tiers.1: Static CSS multi-radial gradient poster for low-end hardware
tiers.2: WebGL2 rendered at DPR <= 1.5 with reduced pixel target
tiers.3: Full WebGL2 rendered at DPR <= 2.0 with full organic distortion

reducedMotion.description: Renders static CSS gradient poster with zero WebGL allocation and zero rAF loops (Decision 14 D-A).

input.touch: None; touch passive with no event listener attachment
input.keyboard: None; container is non-interactive aria-hidden decorative surface

a11y.notes: Canvas element is marked aria-hidden='true'. Optional scrim layer maintains WCAG AA contrast >= 4.5:1 for overlaid text.

props.name: colors
props.effect: Array of 2-6 color values, dynamically resolved from host tokens.

props.name: swirl
props.effect: Vortex swirl strength in the gradient field.

props.name: grainOverlay
props.effect: Post-processing fine film grain overlay intensity.

props.name: scrim
props.effect: Renders an accessible contrast gradient overlay for legibility of child text.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Explicitly freezes the shader animation loop.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Upper bound cap on the resolved capability tier.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.effect: Manual override forcing static poster fallback.

mistakes: Do not combine multiple MeshGradient instances in the same viewport.
Do not run MeshGradient without a scrim layer behind small body copy.
Never call requestAnimationFrame directly to animate the mesh.
verify: Confirm static CSS multi-radial gradient poster renders in server HTML with zero CLS.
Confirm that when prefers-reduced-motion is active, static poster renders with zero WebGL contexts allocated and zero rAF cycles.
Confirm context lease is released when scrolled out of view.
